class Solution:
    def isPossibleToSplit(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        from collections import Counter
        freq = Counter(nums)
        
        # For each number, if its frequency is more than 2, we can't split the array
        # because one of the parts would have duplicate elements
        for count in freq.values():
            if count > 2:
                return False
        
        # If no element appears more than twice, we can always split the array
        # such that each part contains at most one instance of each number
        return True
```
